reviews.comment: This class is a challenging, but rewarding class for anyone who's interested in law. Dr. Carter was a great professor and the class was well organized. I would recommend this class to anyone who's interested in going to law school.

Get ready to read. There were tons of required readings and you'll have to take notes. The quizzes and check-ins were open notes but timed. However, the workload was manageable if you do care about getting an A enough.

Dr. Carter was amazing. I took her MGMT 209 class over the summer and I was pleasantly surprised by how manageable the course load is. There are a lot of required readings and you do need to take notes on them. Her quizzes are open note and open book but are timed so be prepared. Overall 10/10 class and professor.

This class is so heavy on reading. It consists of weekly five question quizzes and pack-backs but they barely contribute to your grade. The final is worth 40% and even if you study you still may fail because her questions are concept based. I know this class is required for the business minor but she is not a good professor!

Reading the textbook and understanding the concepts are super important to pass the quizzes and final. Majority of questions are situation-based and go over specific details. Even if you study and completely understand the concepts and the countless elements that branch from key terms, it is still tough to answer her questions.

I loved her! took this for my minor and learned so much in her class. You have to read the book to understand for the quizzes. only exam is the final but the quizzes prepared you for it. accessible outside of class and really cared about her students and wants them to succeed and understand the material. would highly recommend
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Hill herself is a great prof. Her review videos and textbook clear each other out on confusions. However, the worst thing is the quiz and final exam formatting. Everything up to final was open note, open book etc. Not having this on the final messed me up, but to be fair the final wasn't horrible. Her syllabus point system is bad though.

The only grades that mean anything are the quizzes (4 tests), and the final. She gives useless lecture videos and her wording and situations she uses for the quizzes are horribly difficult to understand. She is impossible to contact and you can't ask any questions due to fear of losing professionalism points.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I had assumed that this was going to be somewhat of an easy course and that I only would need to put in some effort every week due to the ratings around me, I was wrong, quizzes require you to read all of the books and retain specific details. She also has everything weighted ridiculously, especially if you're not a good test taker.

The professor is unnecessarily strict, especially for an online course. The syllabus proportions are insane-- quizzes are worth 40% of your grade, and the final is also worth 40%. This is crazy considering how the little assignments are worth. Dr Carter does post review videos, however, which are helpful when studying for the tests.

The class was not difficult at all, just put in a little bit of effort and you will be fine. Lecture videos are not long at all and each unit is fairly simple. Do good on the quizzes as they make up 40% of your grade. There is only one exam, the final, which is also 40% of your grade.

This course is pretty fun.  Makes law a lot more manageable and easier to understand.  Dr. Carter responds to emails and requests for office hours very quickly, so ask if you need.  Read the quizzes carefully, do the videos, and you'll be fine.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Carter was an incredible, caring professor and gave very interesting examples from her experience as an attorney throughout the course. She's very kind and understanding and doesn't assign that much work, just be sure to do what you're assigned and know the material well. Final exam isn't open note so make sure you understand everything!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Carter has been my favorite professor I have ever taken at A&M. She explains the material very well, so it's easy to understand. Exams aren't bad if you take notes on the units and unit review. She is super understanding and really cares about her students.

My favorite professor I have ever had at A&M! She really engages you in class and fosters the most incredible learning environment. The material is definitely difficult but her teaching style makes it much easier to understand the content. Highly recommend!

Carter is the BEST! She is the first professor I had that made lecture make sense and really cared about her students success. She gives lots of extra credit to help your grade. She is always so kind and knows what she's talking about. I would just say read the textbook (short) and absorb what she says in class & youll be fine. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!!

I was sad at first when I didn't get Hailey, but after the first test, I knew I had gotten the superior professor! I loved this class bc Carter made her class so easy and straightforward! There's no reason to buy the textbook unless you don't understand a concept bc her tests are straight from her lectures. Take this professor for easy exams!

This class is a matter of reading the textbook and taking notes. If you have a decent understanding of the material, you will do just fine on the 4 exams. Weekly quizzes with 2 attempts, her tests are straightforward, and she offers 1 pt extra credit per test. Great lady who makes this class as easy as possible and really cares about her students!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Prof. Carter has easily been one of my favorite professors so far. Makes lecture as engaging as she can with relevant real world examples. 4 straightforward exams and easy writing assignments. If your grade suffers with this prof it is entirely your fault.

Dr. Carter is a great professor and she makes her lectures apply to real-world scenarios by giving examples. She is really nice and gives clear instructions on what will be tested. Unfortunately she didn't round my grade up by less than 1 point, so I am a little annoyed with that but other than that she was great.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class was an easy B, but would have to try hard if you want an A. She's very nice and knowledgable, gives extra credit. The textbook was ridiculously expensive, so I didn't buy it and got the content just fine. Would recommend taking!

Dr. Carter was nice, however I received a 79.7 in the class and she refuses to round up. She does not round up whatsoever "due to the university's policies" which is just bull. If it was TAMU's policy then why does literally every other professor round up? But there is a ton of extra credit you need to do so this doesn't happen to you as well.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This is the first time I have enjoyed a class at A&M. Carter gives mom energy and made the class interesting and relevant by using in-classroom examples of the content. Nothing beyond the notes was tested and it was nice to have an easy-to-read textbook when notes got confusing. Use the textbook to get better understanding of the notes.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Genuinely interesting class, I feel like I came away with practical and important knowlege. Highly recomend this class and profesor.

Mrs. Carter was honestly my first ever captivating professor at A&M. Although the content was complex, some chapters so boring you wanted to sleep through class, Mrs. Carter's demeanor and cheery attitude were always fun during lectures. She teaches like your best friend whos in a sorority. 10/10 recommend her over any other option.

Professor Carter is new and she is amazing. She will never put anything on the exam she doesn't mention in class. I got an A and showed up only when she was collecting homework. Just make sure to use quizlet to study for the exams

Dr.Carter is one of the best professors I have had at TAMU. She explains everything very well and in detail. Her course is test heavily so do good on all exams. Also, listen to her examples that she makes for each topic. Overall, she is the best at Mays.

Dr. Carter is absolutely amazing. Her lectures are very clear and as long as you put in some effort you will do great. She is super helpful outside of class and very accommodating to students. You can tell she loves her job and really knows what she is talking about! Take her class if you get the opportunity!!!

Such an awesome professor!!! She really cares about teaching and explains things very well. Attendance isn't mandatory but you usually still have to go because she assigns homework that you turn in during class. Homework is really easy though! Exams are easy too if you listen/study a couple of days before the exam. She gives extra credit as well!

Dr. Carter is seriously the best professor I have ever taken! She is so engaging and makes the class super fun. She goes pretty fast through the material so you do have to read the textbook, but offers extra credit and assignments aside from the tests! Take her class!!

Took this class in the summer and really enjoyed it. Dr. Carter did an amazing job of keeping students engaged and giving great examples during class. The outlined notes really helped when it came to studying as well as making a Quizlet over what is in your notes. Reading the chapter before class also helped with following along during the lecture.
